name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and enables Nginx, configures three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, deploys static site content, applies host security controls, and generates development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and service operation, creates its log directory, and removes selected replication-related directives from the generated configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys a FastAPI application from GitHub, configures its virtual environment and database, writes environment settings, and runs it through systemd.
